name: Reading corner: TARVA on the right wall, POÄNG and floor lamp by the window, dresser by the door, BESTÅ column by the closet
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: a reading corner by the window in place of the bench, plus the BESTÅ column by the closet (F-63). The dresser moved 1.75" up, from 0.4" to 2.1" clear of the door's swing. 11 placed, 12 extras.
bed-1 TARVA queen (floor): as in e, x 94.75-177, y 34-97. F-34: 31" window side, 36" bathroom side, the edge of the bathroom door's 36" landing (F-31); F-33: bedding 31" from the heater face.
nightstand-1 IKEA PS 2026 pine (floor): window side of the head, x 165.25-177, y 22.25-34. F-33: 19.25" from the heater face. shelf-1 LACK wall shelf (top): the bathroom side's floating nightstand, as in e, so the bathroom door's 36" landing stays clear (F-31). lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top), art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): as in e.
rug-1 TIOKRONA (rug): as in e but 1.5" to the right, rot 0, x 41.5-159.5, y 18.5-112.5, 1/4" clear of the chair's front (which rested 1.25" on its edge until the final audit 2026-10-26) and 5.75" short of the nightstand; 15.5" off the heater face (F-33).
chair-1 POÄNG birch/Knisa light beige (floor): window-side corner, rot 270, x 9-41.25, y 18-44.75, facing into the room with the window to its front left. F-33: upholstery 15" from the heater face; it ends 13.75" short of the window's eyeballed left edge, so not under it (assumed-position:window).
floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): behind the chair's left shoulder against the left wall, x 0-9, y 22-31; its reading arm reaches over the chair. F-33: 19" from the heater face.
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall below the chair, x 0-18.9, y 45.75-100.9, 1" below it. F-32: 75.9" open in front of its drawers to the bed's foot; F-31: 2.1" clear of the door's swing: it fits only if the door is where the sketch puts it (assumed-position:door; measure the door first); anchor-required (F-21). plant-1 FEJKA (top): on the dresser.
Walkways (F-30): 36" beside the bed to the bathroom, with open floor before it (the BESTÅ column came off the bottom wall at the final audit 2026-10-26: the walk had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot); 75.9" of open floor between the dresser and the bed's foot; the 36" landings in front of the closet and the bathroom door stay clear (F-31).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains and the reading corner, 12" off it. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall, so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: STOPP FILT underlays x2 under the rug, VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window); PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1, kept just inside the walk-in closet: with the chair and the dresser on the left wall, no floor spot clears the door's swing, the closet's 36" landing and the route past the bed.
Not placed: the BESTÅ column ikea-39429699 (on the bottom wall the walk to the bathroom had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot, F-30, final audit 2026-10-26; the walk-in closet and the dresser hold the linens, and f keeps it on the left wall); the NISSEDAL mirror ikea-30503778 (glass with no safety film on its page, F-21; a dressing mirror with one goes inside the walk-in closet); the STORSEGEL table lamps ikea-60573576 (12" tall, too low to read by; the wall lamps replace them); the PERJOHAN bench ikea-60485339 (the chair takes its place), a second IKEA PS 2026 nightstand (any floor nightstand on the bathroom side stands in the bathroom door's 36" landing, F-31) and the BRIMNES wardrobe ikea-90574800. Same headboard reasoning as a.
Total $1,697.78: placed $978.91 + extras $718.87; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (dresser-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front, and the slim pine pair that replaced them still covered its last 3.75" at 23.25" out. With F-31's 36" landing in front of every door, the bathroom side takes the LACK floating shelf and the bed group moves up 1", so the bed's side is 36" from the bottom wall.
2026-10-25: the heater is 3" deep (Andrew), not the 6" drawn when this layout was made, and the clearances to its face above are restated to the 3" (final audit 2026-10-26); the bathroom door's landing is now 30" (Andrew: "ok"), and this layout keeps 36" clear in front of it.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the BESTÅ column came off the bottom wall, where the walk to the bathroom had to turn its corner 19.5" from the bed's foot (F-30; 36" beside the bed was measured along the wall, not through the turn); the glass NISSEDAL came off the plan (F-21: no safety film on its page); the STORSEGEL table lamps became VARPTROSS wall lamps over the nightstand and the shelf; the TIOKRONA got its two STOPP FILT underlays, as its page asks; the rug moved 1.5" right, clear of the chair's front.
